findings.requirement: Native validation must be executed and independently evidenced before review or audit aggregation; the board must not self-certify its own creation.
findings.evidence: scripts/mros/calibrate_review_audit_board.py:25-26 fabricates the native-validation payload in memory, and lines 58-69 pass it directly to aggregators and authorization without executing a native validator or checking frozen S001/S002 acceptance.
findings.falsifier: A calibration run that invokes the repository-native S001/S002 validation prerequisites and rejects missing, failed, or non-independent bootstrap evidence would disprove this finding.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Require externally supplied, independently captured native-validation evidence and separately accepted S001/S002 bootstrap evidence; keep calibration unable to generate or certify its own prerequisite.

findings.requirement: Calibration must bind to the exact candidate head supplied by the execution contract.
findings.evidence: scripts/mros/calibrate_review_audit_board.py:10 derives CANDIDATE from git rev-parse HEAD and provides no expected-head argument or assertion against 5c7c0d6a75e6b8b56362011fb89b66efa29a64b3; the harness can therefore calibrate whichever checkout head it is run on.
findings.falsifier: Running the harness from a different commit while supplying the required exact candidate SHA and observing a hard failure would disprove this finding.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Add a required expected candidate-head input and fail closed unless repository HEAD, native evidence, fixtures, and all generated calibration payloads equal that exact SHA.
